children: These disclosures are from 13Ds filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission. 13Ds are filed within 10 days of an entity's attaining more than 5% in any class of a company's securities. Subsequent changes in holdings or intentions must be reported in amended filings. This material is from Oct. 15 through Oct. 21, 2026. Source: VerityData

Strata Critical Medical (SRTA) Third Point filed an initial 13D regarding its stake in the organ transport and medical logistics company, shifting to the stance of an activist investor from previous disclosures in a passive 13G. Third Point reported that it purchased 170,011 Strata Critical Medical shares from Aug. 31 through Oct. 13 at per share prices ranging from $4.53 to $5.66, after selling 43,500 shares from Aug. 31 through Sept. 30 at $5.11 to $5.66. Third Point said it believes the stock is undervalued and that Strata's business, while strong, isn't of a scale to support its current overhead, adding that management incentive options aren't aligned with creating shareholder value. The firm said Strata should explore strategic alternatives, including a potential sale managed by a reputable investment banking firm.

Following the latest activity, Third Point now owns 5,126,511 Strata Critical Medical shares, or 5.8% of those outstanding. Shares of Strata Critical Medical have lost roughly 4.7% of their value in 2026.

Crescent Energy (CRGY)Independence Energy Aggregator raised its stake in the oil-and-gas producer to 68,655,357 shares. Independence Energy Aggregator did so through the purchase of 40,000,000 Crescent Energy shares on Oct. 8 at a price of $12.50 per share pursuant to an underwritten public offering.
Following the purchase, Independence Energy Aggregator owns a 16.3% stake in Crescent Energy's outstanding stock. Shares of Crescent Energy have gained approximately 57.6% in value in 2026.

Talos Energy (TALO) Carlos Slim lowered his stake in the oil-and-gas company to 24,500,000 shares. The Mexican billionaire reported that he sold 8,940,000 Talos Energy shares from Oct. 8 through Oct. 13 at per share prices ranging from $16.99 to $17.73.

Following the latest activity, Carlos Slim continues to own a 14.7% stake in Talos Energy's outstanding stock. Slim also disclosed a shift to passive investment intent in a 13G filing on Oct. 20 from previous disclosures in an active 13D. Shares of Talos Energy have gained roughly 59.7% in value in 2026.

Navigator Holdings (NVGS) BW Group lowered its stake in the liquefied-gas shipping company to 3,070,147 shares. BW Group did so through the sale of 988,931 Navigator Holdings shares from Oct. 2 through Oct. 15 at per share prices ranging from $22.00 to $24.66.

Following the latest sales, BW Group continues to own a 4.99% stake in Navigator Holdings' outstanding stock, placing BW Group below the 5% threshold that would require it to report further sales. Shares of Navigator Holdings have gained roughly 22.8% in value in 2026.
